data.title: Health and care insurance contribution notice from 1 October 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK informs you that your monthly student health and care insurance contribution rises from €146.29 to €156.55 from 1 October 2026. The new amount is first debited on 15 October 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer (Muster BKK) has recalculated your contribution because the BAföG-based monthly need used for students rose to €915.00. You now pay €156.55 a month instead of €146.29, collected by direct debit on the 15th of each month, starting 15 October 2026. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer; the app shows the deadline. An objection does not suspend payment, so the higher amount is due meanwhile. Make sure your account has enough funds.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can be deducted as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.

items.title: Monthly health and care insurance contribution
items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag wie bisher zum 15. eines Monats ab, den neuen Betrag erstmals am 15.10.2026.
items.action: Keep enough money in your account for the direct debit of the new monthly contribution.

items.title: Objection to contribution notice (optional)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at Muster BKK.
items.consequence: After the deadline the notice becomes final. An objection does not suspend payment.
